experiment_data.hypothesis: Cross-lingual correctness direction transfers across languages in Llama 4 Scout (48-layer MoE, W4A16): English-trained linear probes at 13 probed layers (0,4,8,...,44,47) will transfer to 19 non-English languages with AUROC ≥ 0.58 for ≥15/19 languages at best layer, with depth-dependent transfer pattern (shallow→deep ΔAUROC ≥ 5pp). MoE architecture with 17B active params provides architectural contrast to dense Qwen models.

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 && cd /root/xling_calib_direction && python -u code/extract_activations.py --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama4-Scout-W4A16/RedHatAI/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct-quantized___w4a16/ --layers 0,4,8,12,16,20,24,28,32,36,40,44,47 --languages en,zh,ar,hi,sw,ko,es,fr,de,ru,tr,bn,ja,pt,vi,te,id,pl,nl,uk --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/activations/llama4_scout/ --gpu_id 0"
